summary: Mixed restoration and conservation pledges aim to restore 36 ha of land and ecosystems and protect 50 ha at Anibare Bay. The integrated package also places 81 ha of coastal areas under improved practices, benefiting 4,802 people. The 36-ha restoration and 50-ha conservation targets equal about 1.6% and 2.3% of Nauru’s total land area, respectively, while the coastal area represents 3.7%. Agricultural commitments include a 23.85-ha sustainable agriculture plot focused on soil restoration, 8.2 ha under sustainable land management, climate-smart agriculture and agroforestry, rehabilitation of 1.5 ha of soil on an old mining site, and a separate 1.5-ha farm extension for staple food crops. The 23.85-ha plot alone covers about 1.3% of current agricultural area; no deadlines are stated.

targets.context: ≈1.6% of Nauru’s total land area (2,200 ha)
